covers: The one port of the OKI MSM6295

entries.name: status
entries.description: Which of the four voices is playing.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 to 3 are 1 for voices 1 to 4 while that voice plays; bits 4 to 7 always read 1. The stream is brought up to date before the bits are read.

entries.name: command
entries.description: Starts or stops voices, in one byte or two.
entries.behaviour: With no byte pending, bit 7 set remembers bits 0 to 6 as a phrase number and waits for a second byte; bit 7 clear stops voices. The second byte, whatever its value, takes bits 4 to 7 as the voices to start and bits 0 to 3 as the volume, and clears the pending phrase.
